question: Pole E is to the north of pole U and east of pole R. Pole N is to the west of pole U and east of pole I. Pole J is to the south of the pole I. What is the position of pole R with respect to pole U?
solution:
Drawing diagram according to the given information,

1) Pole E is to the north of pole U and east of pole R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repe
atermock.com/tb/e16a4fbc8812b1cdba57004495d670643d00fba1076f5122f61aa49876e94423.png] 

2) Pole N is to the west of pole U and east of pole I. Pole J is to the south of pole I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/156520d75104d58a4f216b1d1b10b607df79dace76cdede79b4b53f14ad35721.png] 

So, the position of pole R with respect to pole U is North-west.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4 .
